column1: # Expected w3id.org redirects, tested by apache/test-redirects.sh
# Columns (tab-separated): Accept header, path, expected Location, target check
#   path starts with "/" and is relative to the w3id folder ("/" = the folder itself)
#   {pages} = the https://<user>.github.io/<repo> site the .htaccess redirects to
#   target check: "y" = the Location must exist on GitHub Pages (--targets); "-" = skip
application/rdf+xml, application/xml; q=0.7, text/xml; q=0.6, text/plain; q=0.1, */*; q=0.09
# --- legacy root ontology (legacy_root: main/ontostart.ttl), version IRIs = <w3id folder>/x.y.z
# --- root-level terms of the retired root ontology no longer resolve (passed through)
# --- aliases (testo: sandbox/testo), straight to GitHub Pages
# --- new ontologies resolve without a w3id.org change
